name: Image-Parallel Ray Casting via 2D Texture Mapping
definition: An algorithm that replaces standard ray casting by projecting parallel slices of the volumetric data onto the image plane, calculating color/opacity via texture mapping, and compositing slices in front-to-back or back-to-front order.
summary: Image-Parallel Ray Casting via 2D Texture Mapping is a hardware-accelerated volume rendering technique that projects parallel slices onto the image plane and composites them using 2D texture mapping and hardware blending.
